description: This file defines the Express route handlers for order-related endpoints in an e-commerce backend system, including creation, listing, retrieval, and status update of orders, with associated middleware and Swagger API documentation.

methods.name: post /
methods.description: Creates a new order, accessible by authenticated customers and admins.

methods.name: get /my
methods.description: Retrieves the list of orders belonging to the authenticated user (customer or admin).

methods.name: get /
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all orders, accessible only by admin users.

methods.name: get /:id
methods.description: Fetches details of a specific order by ID, accessible by the owner or admin.

methods.name: patch /:id/status
methods.description: Updates the status of an order, restricted to admin users.
